S1.outcome: Implemented. Config struct gained ScriptGeneration block with Hardsub (moved from top-level) and FfmpegBinary string. All accessors updated: cfg.Hardsub.Tag → cfg.ScriptGeneration.Hardsub.Tag. TOML format changed from [hardsub] to [script_generation.hardsub]. Breaking change: existing config files with [hardsub] section must migrate to [script_generation.hardsub]. Tests cover defaults, TOML new format, and backward compat note removed (no backward compat needed).
S1.problem: Hardsub is a standalone top-level struct in Config. Script-generation settings (hardsub tag, ffmpeg binary, future filter presets) are scattered across the config with no natural grouping. This makes the config hard to extend and harder for users to understand what settings belong together.
S1.proposal: Introduce a ScriptGeneration config block that groups all script-generation settings. Move Hardsub into it, add FfmpegBinary field. This is iterative: start with Hardsub + FfmpegBinary, add more fields as needed.
S1.source: internal/infra/config/config.go — Hardsub is a standalone top-level struct, hard to extend
S1.title: Config struct refactor: ScriptGeneration block
trade_offs: Breaking change for existing config files (need [hardsub] → [script_generation.hardsub] migration)
Backwards compat key adds slight complexity
All config accessors need updating (cfg.Hardsub → cfg.ScriptGeneration.Hardsub)
